scenarios.name: Change command category while an addition is staged

scenario_steps.name: the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | Tools"
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list
the user selects "Sketch Tab" as the command category
the available list displays sketch commands including "Circle (Center Point)"
"2D Sketches" remains in the custom panel list
the target selector indicates a pending change
no custom panel appears on the Tools ribbon
